purpose: Teach: 憶測/押しつける/歩む/破る/取り戻し/引っ張り/とらわれ/奪う

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診断、本気で、絶対、憶測、絶対、で、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、判断、絶対、しません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren — we don't let speculation guide our diagnosis. The whole medical team commits to that. Thank you for trusting us.
lines.style: Measured, direct opening. Steady voice that signals competence without coldness. Slight emphasis on 'don't' to underscore certainty. Warm at the close.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療、本気で、絶対、患者さんに、絶対、押しつける、絶対、こと、絶対、貴院、絶対、なさいませんね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your hospital doesn't impose treatment on patients, does it? I'm genuinely grateful for that, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft, sincere—not performing politeness but asking a real question. Respect underneath, not forced. Trails off slightly on the gratitude.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんが、本気で、絶対、歩む、絶対、回復の道、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、寄り添います、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's right. We walk alongside our patients as they recover. The whole team stays close to them.
lines.style: Warm certainty. Opens gently on 'that's right.' Slower pace—letting each phrase settle. Voice lowers slightly, intimate without losing professionalism.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、医療倫理、絶対、破る、絶対、行為、絶対、貴院、絶対、認めませんね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So your hospital doesn't compromise on medical ethics, even when it would be easier. That matters deeply.
lines.style: Quieter, more inward. Nodding behind the words. Deliberate phrasing—each sentence has weight. Finishing with quiet conviction, not argument.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんが、本気で、絶対、健康、絶対、取り戻し、絶対、た、絶対、姿、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、嬉しいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're genuinely glad when our patients recover and reclaim their health. That's what matters to us.
lines.style: Softer than before. Opening with quiet satisfaction. Slow, steady delivery. The focus shifts inward—less formal, more human. Voice carries something almost tender.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: リハビリで、本気で、絶対、患者さん、絶対、引っ張り、絶対、上げる、絶対、貴院、絶対、すばらしいです、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your rehabilitation team really does pull patients up and forward. It's remarkable, Doctor.
lines.style: Bright but not forced. Genuine admiration—not flattery. Slight lift on 'remarkable.' Pace picks up with warmth. Sounds like he's seeing something he didn't expect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。過去の病歴に、本気で、絶対、とらわれ、絶対、ない、絶対、診療、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、心掛けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We try not to let past illness define how we see someone. Every patient deserves a fresh start in our care.
lines.style: Grounded, reflective. Opening steady and clear. Slight pause before 'fresh start.' Voice carries quiet purpose—this is something the team has chosen to hold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病気が、本気で、絶対、奪う、絶対、時間、絶対、貴院、絶対、お返しになっているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your hospital gives patients back the time that illness took from them. I hear that in how people talk about you.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Slow, thoughtful pace—this isn't small talk. Finishes with understated sincerity. A slight catch before the close, like he's saying something that matters.
